title: Wayfare Pro Programme Terms, Schedule B: Instant Cashout Fees and Limits by Status
content:
Instant cashout fees under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** differ by the Wayfare Pro status recorded on the earnings account for the quarter; the cashout limits and the waiting period are the same at every status.

## B.1 Fees by status (USD)

| Status | External debit card cashout fee | External debit card cashouts free of that fee per calendar day | Wayfare debit card cashout fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Blue | 1.25 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 0.85 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 0.85 | 1 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 0.50 | 1 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 0.50 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 0.00 | 5 | 0.00 |

## B.2 Limits and waiting period (every status: Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Diamond Elite)

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Most instant cashouts per calendar day | 5 |
| Smallest instant cashout | 1.00 USD |
| Daily instant cashout maximum: most cashed out instantly per calendar day | 500.00 USD |
| Waiting period after the account's opened date before instant cashout is available | 7 calendar days |
| Day on which daily limits and free cashouts are counted | The calendar day in the driver's market time |

## B.3 Points of reading

- **Free external cashouts.** The free count is a number of cashouts per calendar day in the driver's market time. A Wayfare Pro Diamond driver's first 2 external debit card cashouts of a day carry no fee under this schedule; the count starts again on the next calendar day.
- **Wayfare debit card.** Instant cashouts to the Wayfare debit card carry a fee of 0.00 at every status.
- **Status used.** The fee row read is the one for the driver's Wayfare Pro status for the quarter.
